verdict.rationale: Postmark's API surface covers nearly everything a UI user would do: sending (single/batch/templates/bulk), templates management, servers, message streams, domains (DKIM/SPF verification), bounce handling, inbound processing, webhooks, and stats — indicating broad parity between UI and API. However, there's no confirmed OpenAPI spec (probe shows 404s for openapi.json/swagger.json) and no independent verification that every UI action (e.g., account-level billing/plan changes, dedicated IP provisioning) is API-exposed, and community discussion focuses on a separate MCP server rather than API completeness. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/spec confirming full UI-API parity, independent hands-on confirmation of edge-case admin actions via API, and clarity on which account-settings/billing actions remain UI-only.
